class.name: UZUWorldGen
class.brief_description: Generates a natural map or a city from one short spec, made for an AI to ask for.
class.description: A natural map has terrain with water (lakes, sea or a river), meadows, rock and snow, forests with clearings, rocks and grass. A city has streets (grid or organic), raised sidewalks, blocks with buildings (floors, flat or gable roofs, windows that glow), a plaza with a fountain, street lamps and street trees. Both get static bodies for collision. Every key of the spec is optional: a preset gives the rest, and any key overrides it. The same spec always gives the same map. A wrong spec builds nothing and says what to change (the unknown key with the closest valid one, the expected type or the allowed range). The result names places to use next with their positions, counts what was made, and holds a small top-down overview image. [codeblock] var result = UZUWorldGen.generate_nature(self, {"preset": "island", "seed": 7}) if result.ok: $Player.position = Vector3(result.places.spawn.position[0], result.places.spawn.position[1], result.places.spawn.position[2]) [/codeblock] From the agent tools: [code]uzu.py map <project> nature|city --scene res://main.tscn --spec '{...}'[/code], or the MCP tools map_nature, map_city and map_options.

method.name: generate_city
method.description: Builds a city under [param root]. New nodes are owned by [param root]'s owner (or [param root]), so they are saved with the scene. Returns [code]{"ok", "kind", "node", "counts", "places", "hints", "overview", "options", ...}[/code], or [code]{"ok": false, "error", "key", "hint"}[/code] without building anything. See [method get_options] for the keys. With [code]"navigation": true[/code] (the default) it also has a [NavigationRegion3D] [code]Navigation[/code] baked over the streets, sidewalks and plaza (agent radius 0.5 m, height 1.75 m; buildings, benches, lamp posts and trees are left out), and [code]"navigation": {"polygons", "walkable_m2", "bake_ms", ...}[/code] in the result. Benches stand along the sidewalks and around the plaza ([code]"benches"[/code]).

method.name: generate_nature
method.description: Builds a natural map under [param root], like [method generate_city]. The places are [code]spawn[/code] (flat dry ground near the center), [code]peak[/code], [code]water[/code] and [code]shore[/code] (when there is water), [code]clearings[/code], and [code]villages[/code] when the spec asks for them. With [code]villages[/code] above 0, village sites are chosen on flat dry ground, far apart. They are joined by roads (a node [code]Roads[/code]) along a minimum spanning tree, routed to keep to gentle slopes and never through water. Trees, rocks and grass keep off the roads and the village squares. The result then also has [code]roads[/code], with [code]from[/code], [code]to[/code], [code]connected[/code], [code]length[/code], [code]max_grade[/code] and [code]points[/code] for each road, and [code]roads_connected[/code], which is true when every village can be reached from every other by road.

method.name: get_options
method.description: Every key of a [code]"nature"[/code] or [code]"city"[/code] spec, with its type, default, what it accepts and what it does.

method.name: get_presets
method.description: The presets of a kind and the keys each one sets.

method.name: height_at
method.description: The ground height of a generated natural map at [param x], [param z] (in the map node's parent space, which must not be rotated or scaled), exactly on the terrain's triangles. NaN outside the map.

method.name: resolve
method.description: Checks a spec without building: [code]{"ok": true, "options"}[/code] with every key filled (defaults, then the preset, then the spec), or what to change.
